utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what still needs attention and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can help keep track too. Just point me to the next thing that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks. Let’s start with the first repair on the list and I’ll keep track with you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a quick look after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks. What should I know before you come by?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the panel by the hall closet. I can handle the rest if the breaker’s still on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring a box of gloves and a roll of tape if the drive needs them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that helps a lot. I can use both of those.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll set those aside and bring them over for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can stop by and take a look after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should work, but can you let me know roughly when after lunch? I need to make sure someone’s home.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I should be there around 1:30.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet, but I heard it might be around whatever the last estimate was.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you check the last estimate amount?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are already showing up with tools and coffee, so it sounds like it’s picking up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, and I heard they’re hoping to get the bigger fixes tackled before the weekend. Seems like a good crowd for it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m heading over to the repair drive this afternoon, and you should come by if you can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can do that—what time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 3, and I’ll save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What exactly still needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the loose shelving in the garage and the front step crack. I can check the list with you and sort out the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo — I’ve got the repair drive organized and I’m keeping track of the list. Tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll get us moving.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: First thing: the front door latch is sticking. I can list the rest after that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m on it, Bo. I’ll put the latch at the top of the list, and then you can tell me the rest.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check in with the others and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Keep me posted, and let me know what I can do next.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check in with the others and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might be a bit foggy, but I can still lend a hand if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I could use a hand with the drive, if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, I’m in. Just point me to what needs fixing and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I can help round up people for the repair drive if you want. Tell me what still needs coverage.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I still need a few hands for the porch steps, the loose fence panel, and the basement window that’s sticking.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with those. I’ll ask around for a couple people to cover each spot and let you know what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m putting together the repair drive list now. Want me to bring it by your place after I finish?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, bring it by after you’re done.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll drop it by as soon as I’m done.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about it. I can help if you want to sort out a task.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure, let’s keep it simple. What task should I take on first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Start with the easiest cleanup, like sorting the donated tools into labeled boxes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me, thanks. I’ll be there after pickup and we can get started.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive if that makes things easier.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d help a lot, thanks. I’ll make sure people know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll let a few more people know too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand with the repair drive. Tell me what you need moved or fixed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I need to keep it simple: what exactly is being moved or fixed, and when can we do it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check which location is nearest if you tell me the address, and I’ll keep track of where the repair drive is headed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal. I’ll ask the neighbors to send me the address, and then we can point the repair drive to the nearest spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, just send me the address and I’ll help you point the repair drive to the nearest spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I should check the list first, but I think we still need to confirm the wiring and any broken outlets.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. I’ll check the wiring and outlets list first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can lend a hand with the repair drive if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam. I’ve got the list ready, and your help would make this a lot easier.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I can start with the sorting and keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I only caught bits of it. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it’s still happening, though I missed the exact sign-up details. I think they’re collecting repair stuff and volunteers over by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, so they’re taking repair supplies and volunteers at the community hall? I should swing by and check the sign-up details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still on for today. I heard the crew's setting up soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it, I just wanted to make sure nothing changed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I just heard the repair drive is getting organized. I can swing by after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I could use the help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll check in and let you know what’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I might be mixing up the details, Leo, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Just point me to what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure. Point me to the part that still needs work.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think the front porch railing is the part still needing work, unless Leo meant something else. I can help with that or whatever’s next.
